Embedded & Windows Systems Software Engineer
Software Engineering
Full Time
Recruit nextScan, Meridian, ID, US
Yesterday
Requisition ID: 1114
Apply

Summary of Position: (Provide a brief narrative, one or two sentences, that highlights the primary purpose to the organization and key responsibilities of the job).

The Embedded and Windows Systems Software Engineer is responsible for developing and maintaining software for nextScan and ST Imaging equipment and products. This includes R&D, pre-production, production, and legacy products. This role works with our internal sales, marketing, support, engineering, and manufacturing business segments. This role may engage high level customers and prospects and be able to handle internal and external customer objections and requests in a professional manner.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities: (State the essential functions of the job, organized from most to least essential. Include normal day-to-day duties as well as duties that occur at irregular intervals but that are of a recurring and essential nature. Include leadership and managerial responsibilities, if applicable).

 

Collaborate with business analysts and developers to produce software designs
Formulate program specifications and basic prototypes
Transform software designs and specifications into high functioning code in the appropriate language
Integrate individual software solutions to higher level systems
Test code periodically to ensure it produces the desirable results and perform debugging when necessary
Perform upgrades to make software and systems more secure and efficient
Collaborate with technical writers to create documentation for user support

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required: (List the minimum required education, prior experience, certifications, licenses, and specialized areas of knowledge required to adequately perform the essential functions of the job).

 

College degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field required. 
1+ years of experience in C/C++
1+ years of experience working in Windows Development Environments
Experience with multithreading
Experience or proven ability in designing complex software architecture
A passion for programming and software engineering
Experience with SQL databases is a plus
Experience with document imaging is a plus
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
Experience or proven ability in computational algorithms
Experience or proven ability in technical specifications
Experience using imaging APIs is a plus.
Strong knowledge of digital hardware design is a plus
Requires reading, math, basic assembly, analyzing and drawing conclusions from simple to complex technical information
Experience with the Windows API is a plus

Experience using a JTAG/SWD debugger is a plus
Experience working with microprocessors is a plus

Personal Skills and Competencies: (Identify any behavioral characteristics and attributes that would contribute to superior performance for this position, i.e. organization skills, communication skills, detail-orientation, analytical skills).

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
Requires reading, math, basic assembly, analyzing and drawing conclusions from simple to complex technical information
Good analytical, problem solving, and debugging skills
Ability to read/interpret and generate technical documentation
Ability to adjust coding style to match what is already in place

Customer Base: (Identify who the primary and secondary customers are for the position. This includes any person or group of people, internal or external, who rely on the work product or output of the position).

Primary – internal departments (Manufacturing, Support)
Secondary – product purchasing customers

Working Conditions/Physical Requirements of the Job: (Indicate what the physical requirements are to complete the essential functions of the job, i.e. lifting, standing, etc. Also indicate any working conditions that may be out of the ordinary, i.e. travel, on call or unusual hours, exposure to noise, etc.).

 

Requires standing and walking; using hands, fingers and feet
Requires sitting, talking, and hearing
Requires close up (or corrected) vision and color vision
Work is performed in a controlled office and manufacturing environment, but employee will also be required to occasionally work on the manufacturing floor and/or visit customers and observe customer operations in uncontrolled environments.

The above is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job described, nor is it intended to be an exhaustive list of the skills and abilities required to do the job. Rather, it is intended only to describe the general nature of the job. Employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.
